CheckTitle: Ensure OCI Console Access Is Restricted to Administrative Accounts
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Identity domain REST API (read-only admin app role, e.g. Audit Administrator + Security Administrator)
Description: Only designated administrative accounts should be able to sign in to the OCI Console: non-admin users have the console password capability disabled and the console sign-on policy allows only administrative groups.
Risk: The OCI Console gives broad administrative reach; every extra account that can use it widens the attack surface.
AuditProcedure: Domains > Users: for non-admin users, 'Can use Console password' is unchecked.
Domains > Security > Sign-on policies: a rule allows console access only for administrative groups, followed by a deny rule for everyone else.

Steps: Uncheck 'Can use Console password' for non-admin users.
Add a console sign-on rule for the admin group and a default deny rule; test with an admin and a non-admin account.

DefaultValue: New users can use the console password by default.
Notes: Administrators are users holding an identity domain admin app role or belonging to a group listed in ADMIN_GROUPS.
